name: Mezőkovácsháza (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a row of green triangles rising from the bottom edge, charged near the top with the town arms of Mezőkovácsháza (a crowned blue and green shield with a yellow anvil, with yellow lion supporters).
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
